qs.q: An aircraft at FL370 is required to commence descent when 100 NM from a DME facility and to cross the station at FL120. If the mean GS during the descent is 396 kt, the minimum rate of descent required is approximately?
qs.ex: 25 000 ft to lose in 100/396 h = 15.2 min: ≈ 1650 ft/min.

qs.ex: Descent 29 000/1800 = 16.1 min, covering 62 NM at 232 kt. 123 NM level at 320 kt = 23 min: 0422 + 23 = 0445.
